subject.title: feat(anthropic): resolve the bare opus alias to Claude Opus 5

question: Should the existing bare `opus` alias be a rolling alias that automatically follows the newest supported Claude Opus generation for already-configured users?
rationale: The code consistently implements that policy, but moving a pre-existing shorthand changes an established user's selected model without a config edit; this is an intentional compatibility/product-default choice, not a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Adopt rolling family aliases
options.body: Merge the PR and document that bare `opus` follows the current supported Opus generation while versioned aliases remain the opt-in pinning mechanism.

options.title: Keep `opus` pinned to 4.8
options.body: Do not merge this change if existing bare aliases are intended to preserve their selected generation until users update configuration explicitly.

recommendation.title: Adopt rolling family aliases
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and document that bare `opus` follows the current supported Opus generation while versioned aliases remain the opt-in pinning mechanism.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently delivered the merged Opus 5 integration and documented the related alias and Claude CLI compatibility boundary.
